amma_call_first.speaker: amma
amma_call_first.gloss: Hari, where are you? Did you eat?

amma_call_first.speaker: hari
amma_call_first.text: Krishna veetla dhaan Ma. Padichittu irukom, naalaiku exam la.
amma_call_first.gloss: At Krishna's place, Ma. We're studying, the exam's tomorrow, right.

amma_call_first.speaker: amma
amma_call_first.text: Seri, seekiram thoongu. Phone-a silent-la podadha.
amma_call_first.gloss: OK, sleep early. Don't put your phone on silent.

amma_call_repeat.speaker: hari_thought
amma_call_repeat.text: Andha horn sattham… apram verum vellai. Adhu kanava?
amma_call_repeat.gloss: That horn… then nothing but white. Was that a dream?

amma_call_repeat.speaker: hari_thought
amma_call_repeat.text: Sattai en eerama irukku…? Pocket-la manal?
amma_call_repeat.gloss: Why is my shirt wet…? Sand in my pocket?

amma_call_repeat.speaker: amma
amma_call_repeat.gloss: Hari, where are you? Did you eat?

amma_call_repeat.speaker: hari
amma_call_repeat.text: Amma… nee… idhe dhaan ippo dhaan sonna…
amma_call_repeat.gloss: Amma… you… you just said this exact thing…

amma_call_repeat.speaker: amma
amma_call_repeat.gloss: What are you rambling about? Did you eat or not?

amma_call_repeat.speaker: amma
amma_call_repeat.text: Seri, seekiram thoongu. Phone-a silent-la podadha.
amma_call_repeat.gloss: OK, sleep early. Don't put your phone on silent.

amma_call_repeat.speaker: hari_thought
amma_call_repeat.text: Same call. Same words. Indha raathiri thirumba nadakkudhu… aana enakku ellame nyabagam irukku. Notes-um irukku.
amma_call_repeat.gloss: Same call. Same words. This night is happening again… but I remember everything. My notes are still here.

mani_generic.speaker: manikandan
mani_generic.text: Thambi, party ulla dhaan. Inga enna pannuringa?
mani_generic.gloss: The party's inside, boy. What are you doing out here?

mani_generic.speaker: hari
mani_generic.text: Summa dhaan anna, konjam kaathu vaanga.
mani_generic.gloss: Nothing, anna, just getting some air.

mani_overhear.speaker: manikandan
mani_overhear.text: Selvam, sonna kelu da. Indha pakkam vaaradha. Ivanga ellam kudichitu irukaanga… Kadal Amma paathukuva. Seri, seri.
mani_overhear.gloss: Selvam, listen to me. Don't come to this side. They're all drinking… Kadal Amma will look after us. OK, OK.

mani_overheard_again.speaker: manikandan
mani_overheard_again.text: Onnum illa thambi. Veetla oru chinna prachanai.
mani_overheard_again.gloss: It's nothing, boy. A small problem at home.

mani_choice.speaker: manikandan
mani_choice.text: Thambi, party ulla dhaan. Inga enna pannuringa?
mani_choice.gloss: The party's inside, boy. What are you doing out here?

mani_ask_selvam.speaker: hari
mani_ask_selvam.text: Anna… Selvam epdi irukkaan? Unga nephew dhaane?
mani_ask_selvam.gloss: Anna… how is Selvam? He's your nephew, right?

mani_ask_selvam.speaker: manikandan
mani_ask_selvam.text: …Ungalukku eppadi theriyum? Indha party-la yaarum en peru kooda kekkala, thambi.
mani_ask_selvam.gloss: …How do you know? Nobody at this party has even asked my name, boy.

mani_ask_selvam.speaker: hari
mani_ask_selvam.text: Advay sir keys kettaa, kudukaadheenga. Please anna.
mani_ask_selvam.gloss: If Advay sir asks for the keys, don't give them. Please, anna.

mani_ask_selvam.speaker: manikandan
mani_ask_selvam.text: Seri thambi. Saavi en kitta dhaan irukkum.
mani_ask_selvam.gloss: OK, boy. The keys stay with me.

mani_never_mind.speaker: hari
mani_never_mind.text: Summa dhaan anna, konjam kaathu vaanga.
mani_never_mind.gloss: Nothing, anna, just getting some air.

mani_keys_safe.speaker: manikandan
mani_keys_safe.text: Saavi en kitta dhaan irukku, thambi. Kavalai padaadheenga.
mani_keys_safe.gloss: The keys are with me, boy. Don't worry.

mani_after_advay.speaker: manikandan
mani_after_advay.text: Sir saavi vaangittaaru. Naan enna panna mudiyum, thambi? Naan driver dhaane.
mani_after_advay.gloss: Sir took the keys. What can I do, boy? I'm only the driver.

krishna_ambient.speaker: krishna
krishna_ambient.text: Machan, vandhutiya! Paaru da, idhu dhaan life.
krishna_ambient.gloss: Machan, you came! Look at this, this is life.

krishna_ambient_repeat.speaker: krishna
krishna_ambient_repeat.text: Machan, vandhutiya! Paaru da, idhu dhaan life.
krishna_ambient_repeat.gloss: Machan, you came! Look at this, this is life.

krishna_ambient_repeat.speaker: hari
krishna_ambient_repeat.text: …Machan, nee idhe dhaan sonna. Word for word.
krishna_ambient_repeat.gloss: …Machan, you said exactly this. Word for word.

krishna_ambient_repeat.speaker: krishna
krishna_ambient_repeat.text: Enna da, adhukulla adichitiya? Chill pannu!

advay_takes_keys.speaker: advay
advay_takes_keys.text: Anna, keys kudunga. Morning naane drive pannikaren, bro. Neenga poi thoongunga.
advay_takes_keys.gloss: Anna, give me the keys. I'll drive myself in the morning, bro. You go sleep.

advay_refused.speaker: manikandan
advay_refused.text: Sir, kaalaila naane ottaren. Boss order.
advay_refused.gloss: Sir, I'll drive in the morning myself. Boss's orders.

KNOW_SELVAM.text: Mani anna's nephew = Selvam. From the village. Scared about tonight.

KNOW_KEYS.text: 1:40 AM: Advay took the car keys. 'I'll drive myself in the morning.'

KEYS_WITH_MANI.text: Mani anna kept the keys. Advay can't drive.

end_card.title: …but someone is missing.
end_card.hint: R  restart from loop 1      Esc  quit
